purpose: Same-protocol Unconstrained-energy (internal name Free) reference for the SC-RVE. It replaces the legacy checkpoint 06_pann/pann_free.pt, which was trained under a different protocol, as the paper-facing comparison.
timing: Frozen on 2026-09-25, after the SC-RVE m=6 constrained checkpoints were validation-selected and their independent test/probe metrics had been opened. This rule does not alter those checkpoints or their reported metrics. For the Unconstrained energy, validation stress alone selects the checkpoint and seed; its test and probe arrays remain closed until all three fits are terminal and validation_selection.json has been written.

model_specification.initialization: Xavier uniform linear weights and zero biases, constructed in float64; reset strain/feature buffers to exact saved float64 scales after constructor
model_specification.reference_correction: Subtract raw reference energy and its full affine engineering-strain gradient; no polyconvexity claim

recipe_in_memory_change: models.names is replaced by ['Free'] in memory so that the frozen constructor build_initial_model instantiates the Unconstrained energy; every other recipe field is unchanged. The feature table is hash-verified but not used by this model.
validation_metric: Mean squared normalized validation stress error divided by the frozen fit-stress denominator; strict minimum over initialization, Adam, and L-BFGS.
stopping_rule_source: adam and lbfgs blocks copied verbatim from the parent m=6 rule; the stop-reason functions are imported from train_sc_m06_v1.py
selection: After all three fits are terminal, select the minimum validation score; the seed number breaks exact ties. Report all three seeds.
evaluation_gate: Test and probe arrays remain closed until all three reports and checkpoint hashes are verified and validation_selection.json exists.
comparison_scope: Same labels, split, scaling, objective weights, optimizer settings and stopping rule as the SC-RVE m=6 constrained models. The architecture and Adam learning rate differ as frozen in the recipe; this is not a parameter-matched comparison.
